basic_info.description: Exceptional Excelsior! This well-maintained, Midcentury home retains its vintage charm. A large skylight brightens the entry stairs leading to a gracious living room with parquet floors and a wood-burning fireplace. The eat-in kitchen offers expansive views north and west and receives natural light from an additional skylight. The tiled bathroom has a walk-in shower and separate soaking tub, both brightened by the home's third skylight. There are two generously sized bedrooms, each with newly refinished hardwood floors and sliding glass doors that open directly to a back porch. This partially enclosed sanctuary provides additional living space and has sweeping views of Bernal Hill, the SF skyline, and the Bay. From there it's a few steps down to a fenced yard with a large patio and mature landscaping. Unusual for the neighborhood, this home features off-street parking for up to four cars - two in the garage and two in the driveway. A full height space at the rear of the garage invites future expansion. Enjoy living in the Excelsior where the weather is sunny and San Francisco's second largest open space, McLaren Park, is only a few blocks away. Walk from your front door to the many excellent stores and restaurants on Mission Street.
